Derived metadata is `MemoPayload.Property`, stored directly. Tags may also be stored via the same rebuild.

Snippet is computed at read time. Stored fields include Property and Tags. Property drives list filtering. Snippet drives preview text.

The primary extraction site is `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (`ExtractProperties` / `ExtractAll`). `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (`RebuildMemoPayload`) persists both Property and Tags during rebuilds.

Triggers are `CreateMemo` and `UpdateMemo` when the content field is modified. A batch rebuild via `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` exists but is not wired into server startup.

Extracted properties are `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `ks`, and `title` (from the first H1).

Tags are extracted separately into their own payload field.

The extraction pass updates both tags and Property together. The Property struct contains five fields. Mentions are not stored in the payload.

h14.

**Computation site:** `internal/markdown/markdown.go` — goldmark AST walk in `ExtractProperties()` / `ExtractAll()` (shared logic in `ExtractAll` at lines 383–408); persisted onto the memo via `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` → `RebuildMemoPayload()`, which calls `ExtractAll()` and writes `memo.Payload.Property` (and `memo.Payload.Tags` in the same pass). Schema: `proto/store/memo.proto` (`MemoPayload.Property`, described as “calculated properties from the memo content”).

**Triggers:** `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — `CreateMemo()` always calls `RebuildMemoPayload()` before insert (line 108); `UpdateMemo()` calls it only when the update mask includes `"content"` (lines 436–451). `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` also defines `RunOnce()` to batch-rebuild all memos, but it is not started from `server/server.go` in this repo.

**Extracted properties:** From markdown content into `MemoPayload.Property`: `has_link` (link nodes), `has_task_list` (task checkboxes), `has_code` (code block/span nodes), `has_incomplete_tasks` (unchecked task items), and `title` (plain text of the first block-level H1, if any). The same `ExtractAll()` pass also extracts `#tags` into `MemoPayload.tags` (not part of `Property`). List/preview text snippets are computed separately at read time in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` → `getMemoContentSnippet()` via `GenerateSnippet()` and are not stored in the payload.
